name: Basic freeway, FFS 70 mi/h (HCM 7)
source: HCM 7th ed., Exhibit 12-4 (PDF pp. 818-819) and Exhibit 12-6 (p. 822): basic freeway segment capacity under base conditions at FFS 70 mi/h (c = 2,200 + 10(FFS - 50), c <= 2,400); FFS converted at 0.44704 m/s per mi/h. Ultimate (base) capacity, not BPR's practical capacity; pc taken as PCU; base conditions assume no heavy vehicles (D304).

jamDensity.source: HCM 7th ed., Exhibit 10-7 (PDF p. 657): jam density default 190 pc/mi/ln (range 150-270), divided by 1.609344 km/mi; pc taken as PCU (D304).
